reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, and I don't need another thing I'll quit after a week. $25 to $30 a month is real money on my budget.
objection: Foil sachets are more packaging waste, and I'd probably still forget to take them. I'd be paying for a pretty box on top of something I already own.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price, around $15 for 30 days, or a cheap trial of 5 to 7 sachets so I can see if I'd actually use them.
